label: Bible Study
prompt: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and _____ one another, even as also ye do.
verse: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
note: Comfort and build each other up — Paul notes the Thessalonians were already doing it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: As one whom his _____ comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
verse: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
note: As a mother comforts her child — one of the Bible's tenderest pictures of God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For we are unto God a sweet _____ of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
verse: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
note: Paul says believers are a 'sweet savour' of Christ to God — a fragrance that fills the room.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the _____ of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
verse: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
note: Even a king's heart is like irrigation water — God channels it wherever he chooses.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great _____, and sin against God?
verse: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
note: Joseph to Potiphar's wife: not 'I might get caught' but 'how can I sin against God?' — integrity in one question.
